column1: Replies matching the patterns below are left out of a post's replies, so a spam reply never shows. A reply and the replies shown under it are checked and left out as one. Normal replies keep their order.
column2: 符合下方規則的回覆不會列在貼文的回覆中，垃圾回覆因此不會出現。一則回覆和顯示在它下方的回覆會一起檢查、一起移除。一般回覆會維持原本的順序。

column1: One pattern a line, or separated by commas. A shop's domain such as shopee.vn takes out the replies linking to it.
column2: 每行一條規則，或以逗號分隔。輸入 shopee.vn 這類商店網域，就會移除連到該網站的回覆。

column1: One pattern a line, or separated by commas. Matched whatever the letter case.

column1: Replies with a web link are left out, whatever the patterns say. Add a bare site name such as shopee.vn as a pattern.
